A '''battle''' of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]], was fought in [[3996 BBY]]. At the [[Churba system]], the two sides fought with the Republic emerging as the victors.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the course of the Great Sith War rather than described in prose. In the ''Atlas'', the Churba system is denoted as the "New Cov system"<ref name="TEA" /> after the planet of [[New Cov/Legends|New Cov]], which it contains.
